splits.method: stratified by family, 90/5/5 train/val/test, per-family shuffle with random.Random(42); same algorithm as v0.1/v0.2/v0.3 (scripts/build_v01_dataset.py, build_v02_dataset.py, build_v03_dataset.py)

validation.note: v0.4 = v0.3 corpus (2,080, validated at v0.3) + batch 6 (1,200, flags from gen run 006, which included a mutation-tested intent-match self-check gate: 16/16 hand-corrupted rows caught). The full 3,280-row corpus was additionally audited with scripts/intent_match.py: 3,154/3,280 pass. The 126 flagged rows fall in two documented checker extraction-limit classes, both independently re-verified with zero real mismatches: (1) 81 vlan_l2 rows (23 batch-5 + 58 batch-6) where the checker mis-pairs port groups across multiple assignment sentences - all 1,062 intent port->VLAN pairs in those rows were independently re-parsed clause-by-clause and verified against the configs; (2) 45 batch-6 trunk_svi rows in the 'is a trunk permitting VLANs ...' style, where the checker's trunk_coverage extraction fails - all 78 intent trunks (allowed-VLAN sets + native VLANs) were independently re-parsed and verified, agreeing with gen run 006's own re-check of the same 45 style-5 rows. The checker was not modified. See data/v0.4/intent_match_results.jsonl.

integrity.routable_ip_tokens: all globally-routable dotted quads are OSPF/BGP router-id identifiers (conventional lab placeholders, e.g. 1.1.1.1) in v0.1 seed-era rows; every assigned address, peer, network and next-hop is RFC1918 or an IETF documentation range
